verdict.rationale: Hugging Face offers inference through Inference Providers, so a batch-inference discount is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents only real-time, OpenAI-compatible calls billed at the same rates as the underlying provider. A generic "run a job on Hugging Face infrastructure" CLI mention is an adjacent feature, not an asynchronous batch inference API, and no batch discount is documented anywhere.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch inference jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing
